blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Ladner Rural Guide

items.t: : ALR residences cannot be stratified. The Agricultural Land Commission's Information Bulletin 09 (issued October 18, 2022), s. 6, treats strata plans as plans that cause subdivision; under the Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1) a person must not subdivide agricultural land unless permitted by the Commission after an application or permitted under the ALR General Regulation, and the Strata Property Act route (s. 239) does not get around that bar. Practical consequence: farm ground in Ladner Rural produces farm houses and farm dwelling units, never a strata condo building — which is why is zero.

Confirm ALR status parcel by parcel: a specific parcel's Agricultural Land Reserve status is checked on the Agricultural Land Commission's maps by PID or civic address; the ALC states its online tools are for general reference only, with official confirmation from its Mapping and GIS team.

A1 dwelling rules (the housing this ground actually allows): farming is a principal use in the A1 zone, and accessory uses include a farm house accessory to farming, one secondary suite accessory to a farm house, an accessory farm dwelling unit, migrant farm worker housing, and equestrian facilities to a maximum of 40 permanent stalls accessory to farming. One farm house per lot is permitted, maximum total floor area 500 m², on a farm home plate of at most 3,600 m² (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate); one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot — maximum 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less, 186 m² on lots over 40 ha — located on the same farm home plate, with ALC approval required for more than one; an additional farm house (180 m² maximum on lots under 8 ha, 233 m² on lots of 8 ha or more) requires a Professional Agrologist's report supporting its necessity and written ALC approval.

Subdivision of farm land: in the A1 zone (s. 10.10.8), subdivision is not permitted except where it complies with the Official Community Plan Bylaw and has been approved under the Agricultural Land Commission Act if applicable; the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision is 8 ha, with a home site severance exception under ALC policy.
Delta plan and zoning: the OCP is the consolidated Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), adopted July 8, 2024; farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)".

Form B (for completeness — it has nothing to attach to here): Strata Property Act s. 59 requires a strata corporation to provide a Form B Information Certificate within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. In Ladner Rural there is no verified strata apartment building for a buyer to request one from; if a float-home interest is presented as strata, the Form B and the strata plan are exactly the documents that would prove it — request them before treating any such claim as fact.

Depreciation reports and CRF (strata rules, stated for the same reason): since July 1, 2024, stratas with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, no deferral by vote; and since November 1, 2023, stratas must contribute at least 10% of the operating fund to the CRF. These rules bind strata corporations — none is verified in this sub-area.

Rental and age bylaws (strata rules): rental-restriction bylaws are void since November 24, 2022, and only a 55+ age bylaw is lawful (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 and Regulation 7.01, with exemptions for legacy residents, live-in caregivers and, from May 1, 2023, younger spouses/partners and defined children) — both are strata-bylaw rules and neither has a verified building to apply to in Ladner Rural.
Farm class — guide-page wording flagged: Do not quote the guide page's farm-class card as the test.

items.t: Subdivision of farm land (A1 s. 10.10.8): in the A1 zone, subdivision is not permitted except where it complies with the Official Community Plan Bylaw and has been approved under the Agricultural Land Commission Act if applicable, and the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision is 8 ha, with a home site severance exception under ALC policy.

ALR block — the governing frame for most of this ground: residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Delta's A1 text states the same structure in zone terms: one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot (90 m² maximum on lots of 40 ha or less, 186 m² on lots over 40 ha) on the same farm home plate as the farm house, ALC approval required for more than one; an additional farm house (180 m² maximum on lots under 8 ha, 233 m² on lots of 8 ha or more) requires a Professional Agrologist's report supporting its necessity and written ALC approval. Migrant farm worker housing is permitted only where, among other criteria, the lot is in the ALR with farming as a permitted use, the lot is classified as a farm under the Assessment Act, written ALC approval has been obtained, the farm employing the workers is at least 8 ha and the lot is at least 4 ha.
Farm class — three-tier, in full: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an error.

: if a given unit is a strata lot (including a bare-land strata lot), Form B (SPA s. 59) applies — within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25¢/page, with rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report attached; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is not a valid age bylaw.

Migrant worker housing has a hard size gate. A1 permits it only where the employing farm is at least 8 ha and the lot at least 4 ha, the lot is in the ALR and farm-classified, and written ALC approval is in hand — and new buildings for it must be manufactured homes on a temporary foundation or footings. A parcel under those thresholds cannot add it by right.

The 8 ha rule is a subdivision floor, not a parcel description. Existing Ladner Rural parcels are smaller than 8 ha in the feed (listing-text acreages) — the 8 ha figure is the minimum size of a NEW lot created by subdivision in A1, not a statement that every farm parcel meets it.
